title: convert a long script, then promote it

phases.job: Your team's script, from_your_team/weekly.hql, writes three tables of mart, a database you can't write to; it has run, so they hold its rows. Make your own copy of each in your Dev Database, named as its original, such as mart_dev.team_fails for mart.team_fails, written and checked against its original, then carry them to your Prod Database, written there, with the Toolbox. Your Dev Database is mart_dev, and your Prod Database is team_prod. Each new table you make goes in the folder /data/team/<its database>.db/<its name>, such as /data/team/mart_dev.db/weekly; a table someone else made stays where it is.
